verdict.rationale: Better Auth ships a first-party Device Authorization plugin that implements the RFC 8628 OAuth 2.0 Device Authorization Grant, explicitly naming CLI applications as a target. The docs also say the flow can be tested right away with the Better Auth CLI. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the device flow, explicit coverage of headless AI agents (only CLIs/devices are named), and detail on token lifetimes and polling behavior.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can authenticate CLIs and headless agents via the OAuth device authorization flow instead of pasting long-lived secrets

citations.quote: The Device Authorization plugin implements the code issuance and approval flow from the OAuth 2.0 Device Authorization Grant
for limited-input devices such as smart TVs, CLI applications, IoT devices, and gaming consoles.
You can test the device authorization flow right now using the Better Auth CLI
